{{Unknown name}} [[File:Stephanie father.png|250px|thumb|Stephanie's father]] '''Stephanie's father''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG034|Having a Wailord of a Time]]''. He is the father of the starting {{pkmn|Trainer}} {{OBP|Stephanie|AG034}}. He accompanied his daughter to the [[Slateport City]] [[Pokémon Center]] so she could choose her [[first partner Pokémon]]. After his daughter chose {{p|Mudkip}}, the {{p|Treecko}} attracted his attention, and he asked [[Nurse Joy]] if he could have it as his own first partner Pokémon. Nurse Joy allowed him to be its Trainer, saying it was never too late to start. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |width=68 |trainer=Stephanie's father |pkmn=Treecko |type1=Grass |img=Stephanie father Treecko.png |epnum=AG034 |epname=Having a Wailord of a Time |vajp=Yūji Ueda |vaen=Dan Green |desc=Stephanie's father's {{p|Treecko}} was looked after by {{Ash}} and [[Max]]. It seemed to take a liking to [[Ash's Treecko]] in that it too held something in its mouth, in its case a flower. It was upset that it wasn't chosen by Stephanie, but in the end, it was taken home by Stephanie's father. None of Treecko's moves are known.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{emerald color light}}|bordercolor={{emerald color}} |ja=小西克幸 ''[[Katsuyuki Konishi]]'' |en=[[Carter Cathcart|Jimmy Zoppi]] |ar=فادي الرفاعي ''Fadi Rifai'' |es_eu=Eduardo del Hoyo |fr_eu=Jean-Marc Delhausse |it=Maurizio Scattorin |pt_br=José Parisi Jr. |pl=Jacek Kałucki}}
